title: Alibaba rolls out revamped Qwen chatbot as model pricing drops
summary: Alibaba is updating its artificial intelligence chatbot Qwen as it pushes to catch up with tools like OpenAI’s ChatGPT. The revised app replaces the older Tongyi version and became available on both major app stores on Friday, last week.
